model_identity_scope: Same checkpoint across baseline and FR arms; local checkpoint identity/placement retained only in local evidence.

credit.scope: Reduced native-MTP draft vocabulary adoption; independently built map, existing SGLang FR-Spec support

definitions.c1: Client post-first-token rate, not whole-request rate
definitions.c4: All completion tokens divided by synchronized whole-request makespan, including TTFT; not sum of stream rates
definitions.design: Sequential session arms; two baseline boots separated by reboot, not randomized confidence bounds

reasoning.timing_caveat: Logged aggregate scheduler interval samples, grouped by current running count; not per-request, exact occupancy-duration attribution, or time-weighted throughput. Boundary intervals can include previous occupancy.
reasoning.grading: Opaque paired packets; qualitative lock before mapping/operational metadata and mechanical caps; parent review, not independent panel
